text: Data contracts document runtime data structures so tools read process memory without an exact-match DAC/DBI (security, servicing, acquisition, cross-architecture). The runtime publishes a contract descriptor: globals, type layouts and contract versions. Versions are strings like c1, different not newer; incompatible changes need a new version, amendments must be compatible, and versions are fixed from the first RC. The reader version is advisory. See docs/design/datacontracts/datacontracts_design.md and reader-version-history.md.
